## Natural history notes

A small orb-weaving spider characterized by its hard, flattened, brightly colored abdomen with black spots and short spine-like projections around the edges. In Florida, it is commonly found in forests, hammocks, gardens, yards, parks, and other areas with shrubs or trees for web attachment. It builds circular webs in open spaces and feeds on small flying insects caught in the web.
